sections.title: Applied Research Methods to Inform Policy and Practice
sections.description: The class is designed to provide students with a grounding in the theory and application of policy creation and implementation processes, as well as the knowledge and tools to guide program and policy evaluation, including the alignment of questions to appropriate methods of research; judging the quality of research evidence; and designing strong analysis and evaluation strategies.
